scope: Replayable grading contract for the bounded #4102 proposed reference. It evaluates revision-bound source-trace records only; it does not evaluate live runtime behavior, general workflow completeness, semantic production truth, or future architecture choices.

deterministic_grader.boundary: The grader uses candidate field values and pinned case metadata; it does not branch on control identifiers or input filenames. The controls and candidates remain grader-only material. The executable does not assert who invoked it or whether that invocation was independent.

independence_receipts.authority: Independence is an external process fact recorded by a separately authored receipt, never by deterministic grader output.

preserved_receipts.reason: A separate grader execution against the corrected controls passed the correct replay and every declared negative control; repeated grading outputs were byte-identical.

timing_fields.total_duration_seconds: Measured duration for the declared observation boundary, or null when unavailable.
timing_fields.total_tokens: Observed tokens for the declared observation boundary, or null when unavailable.
timing_fields.model: Actual model identity when exposed; otherwise null.
timing_fields.tools: Actual tool identities when exposed; otherwise an empty list with unavailable reason in run.json.

source_replay.method: Resolve each source path at the case revision from Git, compare the declared blob identity, and check every cited passage against the exact blob before grading.
rejection_conditions: source revision differs from the case manifest
declared blob does not match the Git object
passage byte range is invalid or does not match its digest
record uses a source packet not declared by the case

grading_dimensions: actor fidelity, including executor versus loaded-profile distinction
known source uncertainty and contradiction labeling
procedure: Freeze the source packet, source-question packet, verifier-input manifest, control revision, grader rubric, and executor environment before execution.
Run two fresh source-only verifier contexts per case with only the declared verifier inputs and preserve their raw outputs before comparison.
Verify source identities and cited passages by source replay.
Adjudicate every material disagreement and shared omission against source; retain raw records and mark verified, refuted, or unresolved.
Run the independent grader on correct and defective controls after outputs freeze; write observed grades beside the matching run timing.
Report unavailable telemetry as null or an explicit unavailable field. Do not estimate tokens, model, cost, or duration.
Bind any acceptance statement to the final corpus revision and the complete record inventory.

observed_control_grades.negative_control_outcomes: all five declared controls rejected for their intended reason
